newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil exported 1.8 mln tns soybeans in May - SGS.
newsitem.headline: Brazil exported 1.8 mln tns soybeans in May - SGS.

text.p: Brazil exported 1.80 million tonnes of soybeans in May, up 49.4 percent from April, inspection company SGS do Brasil said.
Exports of soymeal were stable at 1.20 million tonnes while soyoil exports increased 53.1 percent month-on-month to 181,900 tonnes, SGS said. There were no comparisons with 1996.
In January to May 1997, Brazil exported 3.77 million tonnes of soybeans, up 81.2 percent on the same period last year.
Soymeal exports fell 11.3 percent to 3.69 million tonnes in the first five months of the year, while soyoil loading dropped 7.6 percent to 445,900 tonnes, SGS said.
Paranagua port remained the main soy shipper with 2.41 tonnes soybeans, 2.05 million tonnes soymeal and 278,100 tonnes soyoil loaded between January and May.
Rio Grande ranked second with 510,000 tonnes soybeans, 671,200 tonnes soymeal and 137,800 tonnes soyoil. Sao Francisco was third with 661,500 tonnes soymeal and 30,000 tonnes soyoil.
